info.title: Forge
info.description:
Backend API for the **KamiLimu Forge** mentorship programme: cohorts, sessions,
attendance, points and graduation tracking, extra activities, dashboards,
leaderboards, notifications and analytics.

## Authentication

1. An admin invites a user (`POST /auth/invite`, `/auth/bulk-invite` or `/auth/bulk-invite/csv`).
2. The user activates their account with the emailed token (`POST /auth/activate`).
3. `POST /auth/login` returns an access token (1h) and a refresh token (30 to 90
   days, set by `REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRE_DAYS`).
4. Send `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` on every request
   (use the **Authorize** button above).
5. `POST /auth/refresh` rotates the pair; `POST /auth/logout` revokes it.

## Conventions

* **Errors** share one shape: `{"success": false, "error": "<code>", "detail": ...}`.
* **Pagination**: list endpoints take `page` (from 1) and `page_size` (max 100) and
  return `{items, total, page, page_size, total_pages}`.
* **Rate limiting**: login, activation and reset requests are limited per client IP;
  over the limit you get `429`.
* **Access control**: users see their own records, peer mentors their group and
  committee members read their cohort. System Admins and Program Leads manage
  cohorts; the Program Delivery Lead runs peer mentorship sessions.

## Roles

`admin`, `program_lead`, `committee`, `program_delivery_lead`, `mentee`,
`peer_mentor_1_1`, `peer_mentor_ict`, `professional_mentor`, `alumni`.

post.description:
Invite a user by email. **Admin only.**

The invitation link expires after `INVITATION_TOKEN_EXPIRE_DAYS` (default 7).
Roles are granted on activation, scoped to `cohort_id` when given, in which case
the user is also enrolled in that cohort.

Invite many users at once (e.g. a whole cohort) with their profile fields.
**Admin only.**

ICT tracks and peer mentors are not part of the import: mentees choose their
track during track selection and peer mentors are assigned later. Each user is
processed independently; the response reports success or the failure reason
per email.

Invite users from a CSV upload. **Admin only.**

Required columns: `email,first_name,last_name,roles`. Separate multiple roles
with `;`, e.g. `peer_mentor_1_1;alumni`. Optional profile columns: `university,
programme_of_study, degree_level, gender, phone, birthday, linkedin, github,
instagram, twitter, website`. ICT track and peer mentor columns are rejected:
both are assigned later. Invalid rows are reported and skipped.

get.description: Validate an invitation token and return who it is for (used by the activation page).

post.description:
Activate an invited account by setting a password; returns a token pair.

Password rules: at least 8 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase
letter and a digit.

Exchange email and password for an access token (1h) and a refresh token
whose lifetime is set by `REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRE_DAYS` (30 to 90 days).

Send the access token as `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`.

Rotate tokens: the submitted refresh token is revoked and a new pair issued,
with the configured refresh lifetime (30 to 90 days).
Revoke the current access token, and the refresh token if supplied.

Email a password reset link (valid 24h).

Always succeeds, so the response never reveals whether an account exists.
Set a new password using the token from the reset email.

Re-check your password before a sensitive action such as graduating a
cohort. Send the returned token as `X-Confirmation-Token`; it expires after
`CONFIRMATION_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES`. **Program Lead.**

post.description:
Schedule a session. **System Admin or Program Lead**; the Program Delivery
Lead may create peer mentorship sessions in their cohort.

Publishing (`status: published`) sets the attendance window from the category:
Thursday and Saturday windows close the cohort's configured hours after
`ends_at` (24h and 48h by default); a peer mentorship session (a task) closes
at `ends_at`, its deadline.

post.description:
Record your attendance and feedback for a session. **Mentees and peer
mentors.**

Allowed only while the session's attendance window (or your approved
extension) is open. `present` needs all nine ratings (1-5, in question order)
and feedback; `absent` takes no ratings. `source` records whether it was
submitted `on_time` or in a `reopened` window.
